register_train_recipe: register a training recipe with its model, task, gangs, and optimizer in the dependency container
register_inference_recipe: register an inference recipe with its model, task, and gangs in the dependency container
register_recipe_common: register common recipe components like beam search, tokenizer, dataset, and profiler in the container
review_register_train_recipe: review the _register_train_recipe function to understand how training dependencies are wired in fairseq2
refactor_register_inference_recipe: refactor the _register_inference_recipe function to add custom inference-specific dependency registrations
